verdict.rationale: Elicit's own docs show operations applied across many papers at once. You can bulk-add PDFs to the Library with no stated limit, tag a batch of uploads, and import whole Zotero collections or RIS/BIB files. Extraction columns pull a data point from every paper in a table, and Systematic Reviews automate screening and extraction across the full paper set, with tables exportable in bulk. Collections can also launch reviews or extractions on grouped papers. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit, delete or retag actions on existing Library items, any stated limits or scale for batch runs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
